sloka: इहागतं मां सहितं भवद्भिर्वनौकसश्छिद्रमिदं विदित्वा ।शून्यां पुरीं दुष्प्रसहां प्रमथ्य प्रधर्षयेयुः सहसा समेताः ।। ६.५९.३४ ।।।।
transliteration: ihāgataṁ māṁ sahitaṁ bhavadbhirvanaukasaśchidramidaṁ viditvā ।śūnyāṁ purīṁ duṣprasahāṁ pramathya pradharṣayeyuḥ sahasā sametāḥ ।। 6.59.34 ।।।।

translations.english: "Coming to know that I am here with you, this side, considering it to be a weak point, the forest dwellers may enter the vacant city and Devastate all united."
